description: This file contains utility methods for database management within the OFBiz framework. It provides functionalities such as retrieving database metadata, checking and synchronizing database schema with entity models, creating tables and indices, and analyzing database structure. The class 'DatabaseUtil' supports inspecting database features, ensuring schema consistency, and inducing model definitions from an existing database.

classes.name: Detection
classes.description: A helper class used to define database feature checks, containing name, required flag, method to invoke, and optional parameters.

classes.name: ColumnCheckInfo
classes.description: A data class holding details about a database column, including name, type, size, nullability, and primary key status.

classes.name: ReferenceCheckInfo
classes.description: A data class that represents information about foreign key references within the database schema.

classes.name: CreateTableCallable
classes.description: A callable task for creating a database table for a specific entity if it does not exist.

classes.name: AbstractCountingCallable
classes.description: A base class for asynchronous counting operations related to schema modifications such as index creation.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Obtains a JDBC connection, registering the driver if necessary, with support for legacy and non-legacy approaches.

methods.name: getConnectionLogged
methods.description: Attempts to obtain a connection, logs and adds an error message if fails.

methods.name: checkDb
methods.description: Main method to verify and synchronize the database schema with defined model entities, including table and column checks, FK constraints, and indices.

methods.name: induceModelFromDb
methods.description: Inspects the database schema and generates a list of ModelEntity objects representing the current database structure.

methods.name: getSchemaName
methods.description: Retrieves the schema name by inspecting the database metadata.

methods.name: getDatabaseMetaData
methods.description: Fetches the database meta data object from an active connection.

methods.name: printDbMiscData
methods.description: Outputs database product and driver information along with support flags for debugging.

methods.name: getTableNames
methods.description: Fetches all relevant table names and views from the current database.

methods.name: getColumnInfo
methods.description: Retrieves detailed column metadata for specified tables.

methods.name: makeIndexClause
methods.description: Builds SQL statement for creating an index on an entity with specified fields and options.

methods.name: deleteDeclaredIndices
methods.description: Deletes all declared indices for an entity, accumulating messages.

methods.name: deleteDeclaredIndex
methods.description: Deletes a specific index from an entity.

methods.name: createForeignKeyIndices
methods.description: Creates foreign key indices for an entity, with message reporting.

methods.name: createForeignKeyIndex
methods.description: Creates a foreign key index for a specific relation.

methods.name: makeFkIndexClause
methods.description: Builds SQL statement for creating a foreign key index based on relation key mappings.

methods.name: deleteForeignKeyIndices
methods.description: Deletes all foreign key indices for an entity, collecting messages.

methods.name: deleteForeignKeyIndex
methods.description: Deletes a specific foreign key index.

methods.name: getSchemaName
methods.description: Retrieves schema name from database metadata, considering schema support options.

methods.name: updateCharacterSetAndCollation
methods.description: Updates character set and collation settings for an entity's database table and columns.
